senses.gloss:
ऋधत् a. Ved.
—1 Prospering thriving.
—2 Exceedingly swift (as horses); दश श्यावा ऋधद्रयो Rv. 8. 46. 23.
ऋधत् + .{@˚द्वार@} having abundant wealth; ऋधद्वारा याग्नये ददाश Rv. 6. 3. 2.

ऋधज्(क्) ind.
—1 Separately.
—2 Aside, apart.
—3 Singly, one by one.
—4 Particularly.
—5 Truly.
